# Behavior Spec Checklist

Use this before implementation.

## Scope

- Smallest visible behavior change is stated.
- Out-of-scope behavior is stated.

## Allowed Behavior

- Expected controls are listed.
- Expected state transitions are listed.
- Expected animation or visual feedback is listed when relevant.

## Forbidden Behavior

- Regression cases are listed.
- Disallowed transitions are listed.
- Invalid input results are listed when relevant.

## Validation

- Manual test scenarios are concrete and repeatable.
- Each scenario includes expected result.
- At least one scenario covers a no-regression case.
